100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 3, 1926, the British Empire celebrated the opening of the Empire Exhibition in Glasgow, showcasing advancements in industry and culture. In the United States, the ongoing debate over Prohibition intensified, with various states grappling with enforcement issues and rising crime. Meanwhile, Italy's Mussolini continued to consolidate power, emphasizing his fascist regime's grip on governance.
